opportunity: KPI and KRI results could not be reproduced from source
action: One definition sheet with source, formula, frequency, owner and threshold for every metric

opportunity: A BEC attempt asked for a customer refund to a new bank account; the call-back check covered supplier payments only
action: Extend the call-back procedure to customer refunds and train accounts receivable

opportunity: Overdue treatment actions were only visible if someone read the plan
action: Monthly Steering Committee pack lists overdue actions automatically from the treatment plan

opportunity: Ransomware precursor began with an unapproved remote-management tool install that EDR flagged but Sentinel did not correlate
action: Add a Sentinel analytics rule for remote-management tool installs and link it to the ransomware playbook

opportunity: Drivers could not report phishing from mobile Outlook
action: Deploy the report-phishing button to mobile Outlook through Intune

opportunity: Online-only awareness does not reach warehouse shift staff
action: Shift toolbox talks in four languages with attendance captured on the scanner app

opportunity: An AI route-optimisation pilot is planned for 2027 and will process driver and consignee data
action: Present an ISO/IEC 42001 gap view and an AI impact assessment approach at the April 2027 review

opportunity: The managed SOC offered a monthly threat summary tailored to logistics
action: Add the summary to the Steering Committee pack and use it to move A.5.7 to Implemented
